tidbit: Did you know… this hour's top stories come from five different outlets.
transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
DeepSeek's V4.1-Flash-1017 improves coding task performance at lower cost. Reported by Startup Fortune: the model was released quietly on Hugging Face.
DeepSeek releases V4.1 Flash new version. Reported by 财新: China restricts or prohibits export of 40 technologies in three fields: artificial intelligence, photovoltaics, and biomedicine.
Illinois creates an artificial intelligence Cabinet and law to regulate artificial intelligence safety, citing risks to infrastructure and public safety. Reported by Insurance Journal.
Anthropic built a new version control system to handle 30 thousand plus daily code merges from artificial intelligence agents. Reported by 36Kr: the system was built with only 7 people in 5 months.
The EU launches enforcement against OpenAI and Anthropic over artificial intelligence safety concerns. Reported by BornCity.
